cars.name: Volvo V40 diesel (2018)
cars.notes: Current car, bought April 2024. Costs from CarPay + manual rows. Repairs Nov 2025 - Apr 2026 (about 41 000 kr): both front springs (one broke, so both were changed), the dust boot that failed because of the spring, and one injector (spridare). One more dust boot is expected to need replacing soon. Rear springs not changed. 167 000 km.

items.name: Winter tyres, 4 new Nokian 16"
items.note: Size ASSUMED to be 205/55 R16 (the usual V40 size for 16" wheels): not checked against the car. Check the sidewall of the tyre or the vehicle data for the registration number. 4 x Nokian Hakkapeliitta R5 205/55 R16 94R XL (studless) cost about 1 540-1 950 kr each at Swedish shops (PriceRunner range; 1 703 kr at dackonline), so 6 800 kr is about 4 x 1 700. Excludes fitting, which is covered by the tyre shift. Counted once over 36 months. The V40 already has winter rims.

items.name: Depreciation (13 %/year)
items.note: The car keeps losing the same share of its value each year. It went from 180 000 to 130 000 kr in 29 months, which is about 12.6 %/year (13 % used). Value after 3 years = 130 000 × 0.87³ ≈ 85 600 kr, so it loses ≈ 44 400 kr over 36 months = ≈ 1 233 kr/month. Change value, % or months to test other assumptions.

items.name: Missed return
items.note: Money tied up in the car, compounded yearly over the chosen months: (amount x (1 + rate)^(months/12) - amount) / months. Earlier it was left out on purpose, since it is uncertain that the money would be invested. For reference, over 36 months at 7 %: 180 000 kr = 1 125 kr/month, 130 000 kr = 813 kr/month.

specs.source: Luggage 335 l (1 032 l folded) comes from press/web pages seen only as search-result summaries (Vi Bilägare, Business Car, Auto Świat); Volvo's own spec sheet was not read, and it is unknown what the 335 measures (to the cover or higher). Length/width from the same pages; height is 1 420-1 445 mm depending on the source. Power, gearbox and equipment depend on your exact V40 (D2/D3, manual or automatic, options): fill them in. Other sources: 324 l for some variants (Carsales, Carbuyer) and 402 l seats up (Parkers, possibly a higher measure). Luggage to the roof with the seats up, 402 l: given by the user, and Parkers also lists 402 l seats up; Volvo's own sheet was not read. The 335 l is then probably the figure up to the cover.

items.name: Winter wheels, 4 used (rims + tyres)
items.note: Assumption: a used set of 4 winter wheels (rims and tyres), about 8 000 kr, bought once and spread over the 36 months. A new car needs its own rims, which is why this costs more than the V40's tyres alone. The lease car's own summer tyres are assumed new or included.

specs.source: Equipment from the Börjessons Bil campaign page for '35 TFSI Proline S tronic' (valid to 2026-12-31): Backkamera, Parkeringssensorer fram & bak inklusive parkeringsassistent, Adaptiv farthållare. Luggage 380 l and 1 200 l with the seats folded, as read on audi.se by the user (an earlier 274 l was the plug-in hybrid's figure, not this car's); press articles also give 380 l. Which line the 380 l is measured to is not confirmed: assumed up to the luggage cover, like the Toyota and V40 figures. The luggage to the roof is not known. The 7 gears and the dimensions are not on the dealer page (from other sources, length varies 4 343-4 381 mm): check the equipment list of the actual car.

specs.source: Toyota Sverige spec sheet YARX_24 (August 2024). Hybrid 130 = 130 hp / 96 kW, CVT. Luggage from Toyota's own table for the Active (front-wheel drive), as pasted by the user: 350 l up to the luggage cover (the figure used here, to match the other cars' 'up to the cover' figures), 397 l with the rear seats up, 460 l to the roof with 5 seats, 1 097 l to the roof with the seats folded. Luggage compartment: 1 402 mm wide, 785 mm long behind row 2, 852 mm high to the roof (AWD-i is 320 l). Length 4 172-4 197 mm, height 1 585-1 595 mm. Backkamera and Farthållare aktiv Plus (ACC) are standard on Active. The sheet has no parking-sensor line for any trim: a Danish dealer lists them as an option, some used Swedish Active cars have them. 2024 sheet, check the 2026 model.
